ITEM 1 | Bright red raspberries, several whole berries clustered at the left side of the plate, glossy with a slightly bumpy drupelet surface, moist and juicy looking, each berry about 2 cm across, sitting next to the blackberries and partly touching the scrambled eggs | 45
ITEM 2 | Dark purple-black blackberries, about 10 whole berries scattered in a loose arc on the left half of the plate, matte-to-slightly glossy with knobby drupelet surfaces, each about 1.5 to 2 cm across, interspersed with the raspberries | 50
ITEM 3 | Pale yellow scrambled eggs, soft and fluffy curds with some larger folded pieces, mostly light cream-yellow with streaks and flecks of bright orange (likely melted cheese or colored pieces), slightly moist with a soft sheen, forming a mound about 9 cm by 8 cm and about 2 cm high, sitting on the right side of the plate | 120
ITEM 4 | Orange-red oily smear and small droplets spread across the plate rim and beside the eggs at the lower right, glossy and thin, with a slight sheen, likely residual oil or sauce pooled in a few spots covering about 5 percent of the plate surface | 5
